# jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_provisioning_profile (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro mobile device provisioning profile by ID, name, or UUID. Exactly one of `id`, `name`, or `uuid` must be supplied.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_provisioning_profile" "by_id" {
  id = "3"
}

data "jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_provisioning_profile" "by_name" {
  name = "In-House App Profile"
}

data "jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_provisioning_profile" "by_uuid" {
  uuid = "beeb6fc5-416f-40ba-bb19-b7a1714f8d83"
}

output "provisioning_profile_by_name_uuid" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_provisioning_profile.by_name.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Provisioning profile ID. Mutually exclusive with `name` and `uuid`.
- `name` (String) Profile name (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id` and `uuid`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `uuid` (String) Profile UUID (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id` and `name`.

### Read-Only

- `creation_date_epoch` (String) Creation timestamp as epoch milliseconds.
- `creation_date_utc` (String) Creation timestamp (UTC).
- `display_name` (String) Display name shown in the Jamf Pro admin UI.
- `expiration_date_epoch` (String) Expiration timestamp as epoch milliseconds.
- `expiration_date_utc` (String) Expiration timestamp (UTC).
- `profile_data` (String) Base64-encoded signed `.mobileprovision` profile as stored by Jamf Pro.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
